events.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout this time—folks are really showing up. I’ll pass along any updates if I hear more.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Pia: That’s good to hear—I'm just hoping the drop-off and pickup times are clear, because I don’t want anyone waiting around with boxes in the way.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Tess: Yeah, that’s the last thing we need—I'll ask around and see if anyone’s posted the times clearly. If I hear something solid, I’ll let you know right away.
